transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Hi. I came in today because, well, I’ve started doing things that honestly scare me. Like, I'll just walk out in the middle of major work deployments, or I'll go driving around late at night with absolutely no plan. It's just... that is not how I’ve ever handled stress before, and I need some help figuring out what's going on.
Have you been experiencing any unusual thoughts or perceptions lately, such as hearing voices that others don’t hear or believing things that others might find strange?
No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or... or believe anything strange. My thoughts are pretty grounded in reality, honestly. It's really just my actions lately that are so out of character.
Have you had any episodes where you suddenly feel intense fear or anxiety that peaks within a few minutes?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I mean, I definitely feel stressed and overwhelmed, but I don't get those sudden, intense spikes of fear or panic out of nowhere. It's more of a constant, underlying tension rather than a sudden attack.
Have you been engaging in any impulsive or high-risk behaviors, such as reckless driving, excessive spending, or unsafe sexual activity, especially without feeling the usual concern for consequences?

Yeah, that's actually what I meant earlier when we first started talking. The... the driving around late at night without any plan, that's exactly the kind of thing I'm doing. And just getting up and walking out in the middle of major system deployments at work. 

It's incredibly impulsive, and I guess it is high-risk, at least for my career and my safety. It really scares me because in the moment, I just don't seem to care about the fallout or the consequences at all. Like I said, that is just not how I've ever handled stress before. But as for excessive spending or the other things you mentioned, no, I haven't been doing anything like that. It's really just the aimless driving and abandoning my job.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts were racing, even if only for a few days?

No, not at all. I definitely don't feel energetic. I mean, I might be up late or have trouble resting, but it's not because I feel like I don't need sleep. I'm actually pretty exhausted most of the time. And my thoughts aren't racing like that, no.
Have you noticed that you're not enjoying things that usually make you happy, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you used to care about?

Yeah, I have. I used to plan my whole week around things I liked doing—salsa, my book club, yoga, or having people over for Guatemalan food. But now... I just don't have the interest. I mostly just cancel my plans and sit at home. I usually just end up scrolling on my phone or pretending to watch a show.
Have you had a history of acting impulsively or doing things without thinking about the consequences before this current period, or is this kind of behavior completely new for you?

No, this is completely new for me. I've never been the type to act impulsively or just ignore consequences. Like I mentioned before, this whole thing with the driving and walking out of work... it's just not me. I've always been pretty responsible and thought things through.

Have you ever had a period of time where you felt extremely confident, overly talkative, or so restless that you couldn't sit still, even if others around you didn't seem to notice or share that feeling?

No, I haven't ever felt like that. I've never had a time where I felt extremely confident or overly talkative. And I don't get restless in that way where I can't sit still. It's just... no, I haven't experienced anything like that.

Have you had a period of time lasting at least two weeks where most of the day, nearly every day, you felt either depressed mood or lost interest in almost all activities, along with other symptoms like changes in appetite, sleep, or thoughts of worthlessness or guilt?

No, not really. I mean, like I said, I've definitely lost interest in my usual activities, but it's not like a constant depressed mood all day, every day for weeks on end. And I haven't really had any major changes in my appetite or sleep, or thoughts of worthlessness or guilt. It's just the lack of interest, mostly.
